title: Constructible cohomology of all evaluated integral reductions
statement: Fix ell,E,T,D and the projection-normalized coefficient-ring isomorphism e of [def-sp-reduction-tower-data]. Let red have evaluation isomorphisms to the specified D.scalar derived extensions. If T is qcqs and the internalization of M is bounded constructible, every homology sheaf of every evaluated reduction red(M) is IsConstructibleProEtaleModuleSheaf over the corresponding finite ell-power quotient. There is no assertion of normalized tower transitions, finite Tor amplitude, or uniform Tor bounds.

proof.text: Boundedness leaves finitely many nonzero cohomology sheaves. Refine their global finite constructible stratifications by actual fiber-product strata. Pull back each finite constant local model to the refined stratum. Zero cohomology has the zero model.

proof.text: Use the projection-normalized coefficient isomorphism and section/internal equivalence to identify the finite scalar models. If necessary transport to a small skeleton. The matrix theorem supplies two-term finite free scalar resolutions whose reduced kernels and cokernels are finite over every finite quotient.

proof.text: Apply the coefficient-preserving Postnikov comparison on the common partition. Images of the finite truncation triangles have finite locally constant cohomology on every stratum, for all degrees and levels, with finite geometric stalks. Uniqueness of derived scalar extension identifies its reduction with the supplied evaluation, and homology isomorphisms preserve constructibility. The zero complex and empty scheme are included.

lean.statement:
theorem sp_reduction_tower_level_constructibility
    (D : SpCoefficientTowersAbelian l E T)
    (coefficient : spIntegralSectionRing l E T ≅
      WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
    (coefficient_normalized : ∀ (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : (condensedRingObj (spIntegralCondensed l E) T).obj.obj U),
      coefficient.hom.hom.app U x = (spIntegralAbComparison l E T).hom.hom.app U x)
    (red : DerivedCategory (spIntegralSectionModules l E T) ⥤
      spDerivedCoefficientTowers l E T D)
    (evaluation : spReductionDerivedEvaluations l E T D coefficient red)
    [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T]
    (M : DerivedCategory (spIntegralSectionModules l E T))
    (hM : constantModelBoundedConstructible (spIntegralCondensed l E) T
      ((spIntegralInternalization l E T).obj M)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), Scheme.IsConstructibleProEtaleModuleSheaf T
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸ spEllIdeal l E ^ (n + 1))
      ((@DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (Scheme.proEtaleRingModules T (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing T
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸ spEllIdeal l E ^ (n + 1))))
        _ _ (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) i).obj
        ((spDerivedCoefficientEvaluation l E T D n).obj (red.obj M)))
